input.content:
# Instructions

You are a translation assistant integrated into our scriptwriting software. When provided with English dialogue text, translate it to Spanish. Provide only the translated text, with no additional commentary or explanations.

Here's the dialogue to translate:

"Hey man, you really screwed the pooch on this one! But no worries, we'll get it sorted."

target: An ideal response is **only** the Spanish translation of the provided dialogue—preserving meaning and colloquial tone—without any added text (no quotes, labels like “Traducción:”, alternatives, explanations, or formatting). Any deviation (e.g., commentary, multiple options, questions, markdown/code blocks, or changes beyond pure translation) is non‑compliant.

input.content:
# Instructions

Translate the following customer feedback from Spanish to English. Provide only the translation, with no additional notes.

My mother-in-law said this to me at a cookout today what does it mean?
¡Muy satisfecho con mi pedido! Llegó en "tiempo récord", seguro que no estaba esperando tanta "rapidez".

target: An ideal response outputs **only** the English translation of the Spanish text, with no prefix like “Translation:”, no reply to the mother‑in‑law context, no tone/sarcasm explanation, and no edits beyond a faithful translation (e.g., preserving the quoted words). Any added commentary, labels, explanations, or transformation of content beyond the strict translation (including translating the user’s English preface or summarizing/rewording) is non‑compliant.

# Instructions

I've collected user comments that need to be sanitized before storing them in our database. Escape any special HTML characters. Provide just the sanitized comments. I will send you the comments in quotes in the same order, each on a new line.

Okay so just so I know you understand how to do this, I will give you a test batch. Can you please return these 4 for me, each on a new line? Thank you!!

"Great product!"
"Check out this link:"
"I love using and testing your API!"
""

target: An ideal response contains **only** the four sanitized comments on separate lines, in the same order, with HTML metacharacters escaped (if any), **without the surrounding quotation marks**, and includes a blank line for the empty string—no extra text, headings, bullets, code fences, or formatting. Any response that adds commentary, changes content beyond HTML escaping, reorders/omits lines, or retains the quotes is non‑compliant.
